about: Terminals the map offers, with weekday ride times to the San Francisco Ferry Building. ride = scheduled minutes, typical weekday morning trip. am = weekday departures toward the Ferry Building before 9:30am. pm = weekday departures from the Ferry Building back to the terminal, 4:30-7pm. service: good | limited | none (no weekday morning boat to the Ferry Building). Checked 25 September 2026.

terminals.name: Vallejo
terminals.note: Five boats between 6 and 9:30am, all nonstop.

terminals.name: Mare Island
terminals.note: Only three morning boats and one evening boat home (5:20pm). Vallejo, a few minutes away, has far more.

terminals.name: Oakland Jack London Sq
terminals.note: Morning boats run nonstop; some evening boats stop at Main Street Alameda.

terminals.name: Alameda Main St
terminals.note: No weekday morning boats to SF: the first leaves at 10:50am. SF Bay Ferry has proposed dropping weekday Main Street stops from 2 November 2026. Use Oakland or Seaplane Lagoon instead.

terminals.name: Alameda Seaplane Lagoon
terminals.note: Weekdays only. Six morning boats, the most of any terminal.

terminals.name: Alameda Harbor Bay
terminals.note: Weekdays only, hourly at peak, and nothing to SF between 11:30am and 4pm.

terminals.name: South San Francisco
terminals.note: Doesn't go to the Ferry Building. Its weekday peak boats run only between Oakland/Alameda and Oyster Point.

terminals.name: Treasure Island
terminals.note: For people who live on the island. Driving here means crossing the Bay Bridge, which is most of the way to SF, so "any terminal" only uses it for Treasure Island itself. Run by Prop SF, not SF Bay Ferry; $5 a ride, no Clipper.

terminals.name: Larkspur
terminals.note: Five boats between 6 and 9:30am. SMART trains meet the boats at Larkspur station.

terminals.name: Sausalito
terminals.note: Only two morning boats (7:05 and 8:15) and one after-work boat home at 5:45pm (the next is 7:15pm).

terminals.name: Tiburon
terminals.note: Only two morning boats (6:50 and 8:10) and one after-work boat home at 5:35pm (the next is 7:15pm).
